objections.detail: _visible_history validates only nondecreasing round numbers and forbids same-role target-round items. It permits an opposite-role decision at the target round before a target offer, although ingest constructs transcript_so_far from earlier CSV actions and a bargaining decision responds to an earlier offer. The hostile event was accepted and changed visible state. Therefore the promised strict pre-action t-1 boundary is not mechanically enforced.

_event_action returns None for an unparseable bargaining decision and extract_event_row_v2 silently drops it. In a synthetic offer plus malformed terminal callback, _finalize_game_rows_v2 retained only the offer and labeled it right-censored. Malformed terminal evidence can therefore change complete/censored membership instead of failing closed.

For the ordinary valid sequence player_1 offer then player_2 accept, extraction correctly creates stop targets 0 then 1 and marks both rows trajectory_observed. _complete_trajectory_rows then filters by role and requires exactly one role-local stop_outcome=1, making player_1 invalid. summarize_oof_v2 makes any such invalid game fatal. The role not taking the terminal action is systematically invalidated, so the frozen trajectory endpoint cannot correctly score normal complete games and is structurally predisposed to fail independent of model quality.

game_channel_objectives returns {} when any validation action prediction is unavailable. aggregate_inner_game_objective then pools only records that remain and can return a finite score. The hostile mutation produced a finite 0.75 while silently omitting the failed fold/game, contradicting the frozen equal unweighted mean across all validation games and allowing hyperparameter selection on partial validation support.

A supervised child created a descendant with start_new_session=True and exited zero. The supervisor immediately certified success while the detached descendant wrote a marker afterward. Descendant discovery and killpg are both anchored to the original child/session, so double-fork/session escape defeats aggregate RSS/thread/deadline enforcement. The campaign-side WAVE5D_EXTERNAL_SUPERVISOR_ACTIVE environment flag is also caller-forgeable and supplies no parent/certificate binding.

The monitoring loop checks process.poll before measuring artifacts and performs no final artifact measurement. A fast child wrote 4096 bytes under the actual monitored root with a 1-byte ceiling, exited, and received a success certificate reporting peak_artifact_bytes=0. Separately, subprocess spawn failure occurs before the try/finally and produced no atomic terminal certificate. Thus neither the hard artifact cap nor the promised one-certificate-on-every-terminal-path property is enforced.
